FLE-001.title: The Fleeca Job

overview.target: Fleeca Bank — Great Ocean Highway Branch
overview.objective: Infiltrate Fleeca's security network, obtain access codes, and execute a coordinated robbery.

FLE-001.intel: Lester Crest begins assembling a professional crew capable of executing high-value criminal operations across Los Santos. The Fleeca Job serves as the first major heist operation, testing the crew's ability to perform reconnaissance, bypass security, coordinate transportation, and manage law enforcement response.
FLE-001.dialogue: Ah ah. Yes, yes, this will er.. do very nicely. Very nice place you've got. Very er… chic. Nothing like a bourgeois bank robber to remind me of how strange Los Santos has become. In my day, the psychos at least had the dignity to be psychotic. Nowadays, it's all about home furnishings and going straight. Right. You ready? Because this is it! Well, it’s… It’s not it, but er… It's something, it's something er... very big. It’s not quite ready yet, but I wanted to see how you're doing. What I've got is a Fleeca Bank franchise. It's nothing too complicated. There's no buy-in. Now, normally, there would be a buy-in. You would put in money up front, we would arrange the job, and you would pull it off, but this time I'll cover the upfront costs. Call it the er… price of getting a look at you. And there's no risk to you. Unless, of course, you count getting locked up or shot. So, you ready? What do you think? You er… got questions. Comments? Concerns? Alright, what are you waiting for? Let's go see this place.

environmentalEvidence.title: Fleeca Apartment Theory
environmentalEvidence.observation: The apartment assigned for hosting the original heists has a direct visual connection to Fleeca branding.
environmentalEvidence.theory: Rockstar may have used apartment views to subtly connect each original heist location with its host apartment.

PAC-005.title: The Pacific Standard Job
PAC-005.dialogue: Well, you all look good. How do I look? Do I look like a model? Like I work at Peckerwoods. Like a regular dream book. Whatever. We all love banks, especially the big ones that take big risks 'cause they just know that if they went under we'd all be dead. Too big to fail? Great idea! Let's put it to the test, hmm? Well, this is a little something I came up with, I er… I like to call it - bank robbing with a social agenda, if you will. It's something I tell myself so I can… get some sleep at night. Anyway, those overly leveraged turds and Pacific Standard Bank, they're going to be hit at their flagship branch. How are we going to do that? Well… It's a little complicated, but there are some trucks. I need you to photograph one of those trucks. has a built-in transponder, and we need our transponder to blip out a don't explode signal to the dye packs when we take them out of range of the Pacific Standard signal. Get it? Alright, don't worry about it. Just photograph the trucks and I'll tell you which one to hit, but once we've done that we need to have the transponder programmed to Pacific Standards frequency on my signals expert Avi Schwarzman he's a he's been on the run for years you know avoiding people and pulled up somewhere in the middle of nowhere near North Chumash you know you go up there you make nice and, you bring the device back and, then I will brief you on the rest. What do you say? Not very much, I imagine. Be good.
